item.title: Analysis of property prices in Portsmouth
item.description:
A selected set of key variables was analyzed to investigate how different property characteristics influence the sale price of houses in Portsmouth.
After fitting an appropriate statistical model, the relationship between price and housing features was explored and visualized through an interactive Shiny App and summarized in a poster presentation.
